title: Out of Scale / Clockwork Desk

sections.intent: Opening five-note idea, with room to look around
Same idea with a different answer and accompaniment
Reach the upper register and change the supporting color
Shorter answers carry the pulse around the loop

brief: Original exploration music, office; a full-file loop with a distinct five-note contour.

association.whole: A daisy garland and cactus sit on a stitched blueprint. Glitter spins off a propeller, a slam and a hiccup make a clog in slimy tar: one desk machine skips a beat.

gives.what: A repeated object recolored at each return
Asymmetric five-note idea with a breath
Synth pluck, electric keys and a quiet ticking rhythm

plan.identity: Five-note rising-and-folding phrase in synth pluck, electric keys and a quiet ticking rhythm

high_point.means: A single higher answer without raising background volume

decisions: Keep a clear light lead and let beds leave room for game effects.
Use installed sample bank and synths. Last bar shares the opening harmony at the loop join.
